changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetTypeExportTemplateField') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetTypeExportTemplateField]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [TemplateID] [int] NOT NULL, [FieldTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Order] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetTypeExportTemplateField] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID] ASC) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_AssetTypeExportTemplateField_AssetTypeExportTemplate') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTypeExportTemplateField] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetTypeExportTemplateField_AssetTypeExportTemplate] FOREIGN KEY([TemplateID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AssetTypeExportTemplate] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTypeExportTemplateField] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetTypeExportTemplateField_AssetTypeExportTemplate] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_AssetTypeExportTemplateField_FieldType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTypeExportTemplateField] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetTypeExportTemplateField_FieldType] FOREIGN KEY([FieldTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FieldType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTypeExportTemplateField] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetTypeExportTemplateField_FieldType] END
